head: 89de9af4b631abdef5673ce8949fb02a32f6fcad + archived workspace

M9-T-L06.U: Two deterministic save-receipt interleavings with and without newer local input: multiple invalidations coalesce to one refresh; no second source write after 6 seconds. Both originally failed.
M9-T-L06.I: Actual native save, native watcher, delayed receipt delivery and independent CLI edit. Clean buffer adopts latest bytes; newer input remains dirty with external conflict. Also verifies external changes immediately after an acknowledged save.
M9-T-L06.A: r12 packaged App: real editor input and Cmd+S; independent CLI overwrites the same file 29ms after saved UI/disk acknowledgement. Latest text appears without refresh/approval, matches disk hash and has no active dirty/conflict marker. Screenshot inspected.
M9-T-L06.boundary: Forced delayed receipt is exercised at U/I transport boundary. App A covers the original specified post-save <5s external-write scenario; no physical keyboard/IME or pixel-equivalence claim.

M9-T-B08.I: Ordinary/CLI writers x native-watch/paused explicit refresh/resume; deleted and renamed tabs are missing, tree accurate. Missing observed by refresh/read/save cannot rebind to same-name/same-bytes replacement, draft independently recoverable. Unobserved replacement, preflight replacement and main-to-native race rejected; original inode restoration and clean atomic replacement remain supported.
M9-T-B08.A: Six actual packaged UI writer/trigger groups plus a dirty deleted/recreated-file group. Refresh uses real menu; stopWatch is explicit public IPC fault setup, file operations use a separate process/ordinary writer. Dirty marker and local text remain after explicit save and 3.2s autosave boundary; replacement hash/inode unchanged.
M9-T-B08.remaining: Full prototype P matrix still absent. No complete case pass.

M9-T-L07.I: Hold subscription before native subscribe, mutate file/create file after initial list/read, release real subscription; resync updates final tree/text without source writes.
M9-T-L07.remaining: Original U/A layers not fully documented/executed; no complete case pass.

M9-DEV-058.problem: Path/hash-only adoption let an old dirty document overwrite a newly created same-name file with identical base bytes. Additional failures: unobserved replacement and replacement between main preflight/native dispatch.
M9-DEV-058.fix: Main keeps missing capability tied to original device/inode while permitting independent checkpoints; returning original inode can recover. Dirty same-hash inode changes enter conflict. Main preflight checks current identity and native save checks exact main-preflight revision before preparing; copy retains separate source/destination revision contracts.
M9-DEV-058.verification: Five distinct red paths across initial 2 failures and adjacent 3 failures; expanded native/renderer matrix passes; actual r12 missing-replacement UI reproduction passes.
M9-DEV-058.boundary: Observed missing identity is session-scoped; ordinary unseen atomic replacement is treated as a revision conflict, not a claimed complete filesystem history. No universal filesystem CAS claim.

M9-DEV-059.problem: Refresh returned immediately during save; if watcher snapshot had already consumed the external event, text could remain stale after receipt.
M9-DEV-059.fix: Coalesce in-flight refresh requests, re-read after receipt/inFlight clearing, preserve newer local input as conflict and avoid source replay.
M9-DEV-059.verification: 2 red U tests -> 17 buffer tests pass; 2 real-native delayed-receipt scenarios pass; original L06 actual App flow passes.

validation.aggregateBasis: Earlier full baseline plus affected reruns, not a fresh full-suite execution. Two existing external-CLI opt-in tests remain skipped.

failuresRetained.result: 10 failures: 2 real same-name overwrite failures; 8 sandbox-native coverage/readiness failures. Normal macOS original rerun: 8 pass, same 2 real failures.
78 pass/1 fail/3 unselected: new target-preflight guard accidentally interpreted copy source expectedRevision as destination. Guard scoped to ordinary save; full affected 79 pass.

34 pass/1 fail: late-callback owner test received snapshot changed=true but zero actual native events during parallel tests. Unmodified serial reruns pass (23, then final 37); timeout retained, no fabricated native event.
Driver initially failed on a temporarily absent row, then used obsolete direct refresh selector. Driver waits before dispatch and opens actual file menu; r11/r12 complete 8/8 each.

package.postSnapshotChangesExplanation: Only the external UI test driver was adapted to the actual file-menu refresh item after the build snapshot; archived separately. All 835 other source/config/native/test files match. This driver is not part of the packaged runtime.
